yappilot.core_function_original: Yappilot is an AI video editor for people who talk on camera. Drop in a recording and get a first edit in minutes: ums and retakes cut, captions in your style (118 languages, Hinglish too), music under your voice and a new shot every few seconds from one camera. It's still your edit: fix any word, ask your own AI, or open it in Premiere, Final Cut or After Effects. Your video never leaves your computer. Paste a long video or stream's link, and it finds the best clips.
yappilot.target_customers_original: Creators, coaches, podcasters and streamers, video editors
yappilot.pricing_original: Free: 1 hour of footage a month, no card. Creator: $19/month (₹799), 10 hours. Pro: $39/month (₹1,599), 30 hours.
yappilot.value_proposition_original: A first edit of your talking video in minutes: ums and retakes cut, captions in your style, music and camera moves, and it's still yours to edit.
yappilot.problem_solved_original: Editing a talking video takes far longer than recording it. Yappilot does the slow part (cuts, captions, music, framing), so creators post more and editors finish more videos.
